professionalSummary: Experienced Credit Risk Analyst with a strong background in developing and monitoring credit scorecards using logistic regression and gradient boosting, preparing comprehensive model documentation, and supporting IFRS 9 model updates. Holds a part‑time MSc in Financial Mathematics and a BSc in Economics.
Proven track record of producing monthly monitoring packs, managing population stability and discrimination metrics, and responding to independent validation findings.
